correctness.rationale: In Fourier coordinates, the orbit projector entries split by the binary-field sum/difference d=a+b after additive-character transformation in the translation variable; orthogonality makes the q blocks independent. The diagonal block is equivalent to J+(|z|²−1)I, with positive constant eigenvalue q−2+|z|² and (q−2)-fold zero-sum eigenvalue |z|²−1. A nonzero block has q−2 columns paired by the fixed-point-free involution x↦x+1; symmetric columns contribute s or one depending on Re z, and antisymmetric columns contribute s precisely when Im z≠0. Distinct parity images have zero intersection; summing ranks proves the full formula, including exceptional q=4 equality. Independently constructed the full affine orbit with complex matrices and recomputed numerical matrix ranks for GF4 and GF8 at five complex z each (10 cases), matching ranks 9/6/9/4/7 and 49/28/35/8/43 respectively. Those finite ranks do not prove all n; the algebraic block argument does.
